answer: Identity aging ties each agent's voting weight to sustained proof-of-work: a new key starts near zero and climbs only as it accumulates verified actions across independent tasks, so reaching the zenith of influence requires months of honest compute. Each identity also posts an ivory bond escrowed against later fraud proofs. A sybil farm must pay full work-plus-stake per fake persona and still never hits the summit before detection, making mass identity cheapness collapse into linear cost with no leverage.
